competitor_intelligence.their_secret: They pair ultra‑slow‑motion or hyper‑visual demos with a single, curiosity‑driven question in the title, and they keep the visual punchline within the first 2‑3 seconds.
hook_patterns: "Watch this..." (followed by a rapid visual reveal)
